prompt: packages/japanese/prompts/reading-validator.md, applied per item: classify each option A-only / B-only / both / neither, then apply the stem. Packet: .cache/judge/tougou-n2-keys-withheld.md, verdicts: .cache/judge/tougou-n2-A.md
note: Round A, pass A over the 8-row AUTHORED N2 統合理解 batch (n2to-1..n2to-8). All 8 PASS and every one was keyed exactly as shipped (8/8). Two loosest: n2to-6's shared premise is only implicit in passage A, which is what a 前提 item asks for, and n2to-2's key compresses the clash (new flow against moved flow) into one line. Correlated-error limit: both passes ran on the author model family, so agreement here is not independence. The two passes differ in procedure only, and the key was withheld from the packet, so the pairing tests whether a reader who cannot see the key lands on one option, not whether a second model would.

prompt: same 8 items, deliberately different procedure: write what each writer wants changed and what each names as the cause, then one line on what the two have in common and one on where they point opposite, then answer the stem from those two lines rather than option by option.
